name: NoGeneralMethodsResearch
summary: The card component of No General Methods Research (DUO_0000015). The requester's project intends to use the data for no purpose the owner prohibits, such as methods development, and the requester accepted the terms. Outputs the DownloadGrantCredential that Grant download takes.

prohibitedPurposes.description: Purpose terms, as they appear in IntendedDataUseCredential.useOnlyFor.purposes, that disqualify an IDU: an IDU is usable only if none of its purposes is in this list.
